# Kenshien Alao

> Web developer focused on building performant, scalable, and maintainable web applications with modern frontend and backend technologies.

## About

Kenshien Alao is a web developer specializing in full-stack web application development. His work focuses on building production-ready systems with an emphasis on performance, scalability, maintainability, clean architecture, and reliable user experiences.

His primary technology stack includes React, Next.js, TypeScript, Spring Boot, Java, PostgreSQL, and modern web development tooling. His projects span frontend applications, REST APIs, database-driven systems, authentication, caching, and full-stack application architecture.
